<p>Sattal is one of the places that is close to big cities and shows a different form of nature –  the world of birds. <p>chanfi is an amazing birding area for small Birds, warblers, and water-dependent Birds. <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-9b0e2e2 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-element_type="section" data-id="9b0e2e2">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">
<p>In a year, about 250 species are found in Sattal –<br/>Some of the rarest summer species are <i>Long-tailed Broadbill, Brown Wood Owl, Gray Croned Parinees, Mountain Scopes Owl, Mountain Hawk Eagle.<br/></i>Some beautiful winter species are – Small Niltava, Rufous Bellied NIltava, Rufous-gorgeted Flycatcher, Golden Bush Robin, Common Green Magpie, Pink Browd Rosfinch.<br/><br/>Some exotic birds also live in the target of bird watchers in winter…. one of which is the Siberian rubythroat – this bird reaches Sattal from the upper cold regions of Europe and China. It looks very beautiful blooming in the middle and there is a desire in the mind to come out for a moment and see it.<br/><br/>There are other areas along with Satatal which are famous for birds and which are visited with the Satatal Bird Watching Tour –<br/>Pangot, Chanfi, Ramgarh, Shyamkhet – These are the areas where there is very good boarding and many such species are found which are not found in Sattal.<br/><br/>Chanfi is famous for – <i>Brown Dipper, the only species which breeds in winters here. </i></p> </div>
